line.en: the julemarked on nytorv and gammeltorv runs 6 november to 21 december, free to enter. stalls, glögg and food; come after work before it gets dark and cold.
line.de: der julemarkt auf nytorv und gammeltorv läuft vom 6. november bis 21. dezember, der eintritt ist frei. buden, glühwein und essen; am besten direkt nach der arbeit hin.
line.tr: nytorv ve gammeltorv'daki noel pazarı 6 kasım ile 21 aralık arası açık, giriş ücretsiz. tezgahlar, glögg ve yemek var; iş çıkışı uğra.

sparks.why: Nytorv and Gammeltorv Christmas market 6 Nov to 21 Dec 2026, free entry, per Visit Copenhagen and StoryHunt; the daily hours were not checked.
